ELIAS VALE, b. 1812, Vermont. — MARGARET VALE (née Hale), b. 1816.
Came west: Oregon City, autumn 1847.

Josiah, b. 1838. Clara, b. 1841.
Hannah, d. of Josiah, b. 1864.
Edmund, gs. of Josiah, b. 1899. Arthur, s. of Edmund, b. 1929.

At the foot of the page, a line has been scraped away with a blade. What is left: "...orn 1871, Witn—"
pages.heading: THE HOLY BIBLE · FAMILY RECORD
